vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Dependabot alerts would not work if enabled: Dependabot only knows dependencies in manifests it understands (pom.xml, package.json, ...), not the download versions in build.xml that are found by the regex manager below. Disabled to avoid the warning that they cannot be accessed

customManagers.description: Download versions in build.xml, marked with a renovate comment on the line above the version property
matchStrings: <!-- renovate: datasource=(?<datasource>\S+) packageName=(?<packageName>\S+)( versioning=(?<versioning>\S+))?( extractVersion=(?<extractVersion>\S+))? -->\s*<property name="(?<depName>[^"]+)" value="(?<currentValue>[^"]+)"

packageRules.description: One pull request for all download versions, including the .bat and .sh scripts generated by build.xml

prBodyNotes: Maven was updated: check whether remark maven.remark.line1 in build.xml is still correct, see https://maven.apache.org/plugins/maven-compiler-plugin/
Ant was updated: progressbarget.jar should have been rebuilt against the new Ant version by the post-upgrade task, check that it is part of this pull request (see extensions/progress-bar/README.md)

packageRules.description: Pinned to 1.7.15. Rhino 1.8.0 and later do not publish rhino-<version>.zip as GitHub release asset anymore, so the download URL in build.xml would give a 404. Rhino 1.7.15.1 does publish the zip, but its main jar is named lib/rhino-patch-1.7.15.1.jar instead of lib/rhino-<version>.jar, which the generated scripts check for (they would copy the Rhino jars into the Ant lib directory on every run) and which has not been tested with Ant
Version 2.4.240 does not work with the FF!. Type datetime does not work anymore
